title: SkillsCheckParams
description: Params for skills.check: which discovered skill's stored reading to read back. One skill, by name — the same bound skills.audit takes, because both name the same discovered bundle. Nothing about a model travels here: this method never resolves a role and never calls one, it only reads a row content.db may already hold and recomputes a digest to say whether that row still describes the bytes on disk.
